WITH quarter AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-07-01' AS end_date
), earned_premium AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        p.annual_premium * GREATEST(
            0,
            LEAST(p.end_date, q.end_date) - GREATEST(p.start_date, q.start_date)
        ) / 365.0
    ), 0) AS amount
    FROM policies p
    JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
    CROSS JOIN quarter q
    WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001'
      AND p.start_date < q.end_date
      AND p.end_date > q.start_date
), incurred_claims AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amount
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
    JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
    CROSS JOIN quarter q
    WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001'
      AND c.claim_date >= q.start_date
      AND c.claim_date < q.end_date
      AND c.status IN ('settled', 'open')
)
SELECT incurred_claims.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_claims
CROSS JOIN earned_premium

WITH earned_premium AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    p.annual_premium * (LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')) / 365.0
  ), 0) AS amount
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_002'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'
), incurred_claims AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amount
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_002'
    AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND c.status <> 'denied'
)
SELECT 100.0 * incurred_claims.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio_percent
FROM incurred_claims
CROSS JOIN earned_premium

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS quarter_start, DATE '2026-07-01' AS quarter_end
), earned AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    p.annual_premium * (LEAST(p.end_date, params.quarter_end) - GREATEST(p.start_date, params.quarter_start))::numeric / 365
  ), 0) AS earned_premium
  FROM policies p
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE product_code = 'product_003')
    AND p.start_date < params.quarter_end
    AND p.end_date > params.quarter_start
), incurred AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS incurred_claims
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE product_code = 'product_003')
    AND c.claim_date >= params.quarter_start
    AND c.claim_date < params.quarter_end
    AND c.status IN ('settled', 'open')
)
SELECT incurred.incurred_claims / NULLIF(earned.earned_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred
CROSS JOIN earned

    ) / 365.0
  ), 0) AS amount
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_004'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'
), incurred_claims AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amount
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id

    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

)
SELECT incurred_claims.amount AS incurred_claim_amount,
       earned_premium.amount AS earned_premium,
       incurred_claims.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_claims
CROSS JOIN earned_premium

WITH earned AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    p.annual_premium * GREATEST(
      0,
      LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')
    ) / 365.0
  ), 0) AS earned_premium
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_005'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'
), incurred AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS incurred_claim_amount
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_005'
    AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND LOWER(c.status) IN ('settled', 'open')
)
SELECT 100.0 * incurred.incurred_claim_amount / NULLIF(earned.earned_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio_percent
FROM earned
CROSS JOIN incurred

    * (LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01'))::numeric
    / 365
  ), 0) AS earned_premium
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_006'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'

  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_006'
    AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(c.status, '')) <> 'denied'
)
